fightSong.title: The 405
fightSong.lyrics: Stuck on the 405, but we don't mind / LA traffic, one of a kind / Brake lights flashing, hear us hum / Traffic Jams, here we come!

stadium.name: The 405
stadium.tradition: The Honk Symphony — fans honk horns in traffic on the way in, recorded and played pre-game. It's cacophonous art.

fanCulture.description: They arrive in the second quarter (traffic). They leave early (traffic). They pay $25 for parking and complain.
fanCulture.tailgate: In a parking structure, level P4.

rivalries.name: The California Cold War
rivalries.narrative: LA vs SF. Traffic vs sourdough. Everyone loses.

paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: TRAFFIC JAM TOUCHDOWN! Clear the lane!

cityFlavor: 10 lanes, 10 million people, 1 team everyone claims.
